pages.title: Blue and red · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Saturday evening at a big soccer stadium in Austin. Thousands of fans sing and wave scarves. Bia sits next to her friend Leo near midfield. Two teams, red and blue, run onto the field. The whistle blows and the game begins. Bia and Leo watch every move.
“Look! Number ten is so fast.” says Leo. “He is faster than the other players.” says Bia. “Yes, but Mark is stronger than him.” says Leo.
